levels.name: Settle (flare mode)
levels.goal: Calm a flare with short walks, relief positions and only the easiest pain-free drills; then return to training one step easier than before.
entry: Entered automatically by an orange streak, a level regression, or manually with the 'I flared' button. Never entered for a red flag: red freezes the plan.

extra: Two consecutive daily statuses are green, with no sharp/electrical pain, no leg symptoms, and standing tolerance at 70% of baseline or better. Then return to the saved level, one rung easier, needing 3 clean sessions to advance.
